```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(leaps)
library(corrplot)
library(mosaic)
```



```{r}

bball_data <- read_csv("Basketball 310 Project Data.csv")

# Creating indicator variables by position and season

bball_data <- mutate(bball_data, Center = ifelse(Pos =="C", 1,0))

bball_data <- mutate(bball_data, `Power Forward` = ifelse(Pos =="PF", 1,0))

bball_data <- mutate(bball_data, `Point Guard` = ifelse(Pos =="PG", 1,0))

bball_data <- mutate(bball_data, `Small Forward` = ifelse(Pos =="SF", 1,0))

bball_data <- mutate(bball_data, `Shooting Guard` = ifelse(Pos =="SG", 1,0))

bball_data <- mutate(bball_data, season1 = ifelse(Season =="2020-2021", 1,0))

bball_data <- mutate(bball_data, season2 = ifelse(Season =="2021-2022", 1,0))

bball_data <- mutate(bball_data, season3 = ifelse(Season =="2022-2023", 1,0))

bball_data <- mutate(bball_data, season4 = ifelse(Season =="2023-2024", 1,0))

bball_data <- mutate(bball_data, season5 = ifelse(Season =="2024-2025", 1,0))

bball_data <- bball_data %>% 
  rename(MP = `MP?`)

bball_data <- bball_data %>% 
  rename(TWP = `Team Winning Pct`)


#best subsets to determine the best reduced model
df2 <- select(bball_data, TWP, G, GS, `MP`, FG, FGA, `FG%`, `3P`, `3PA`, `3P%`, `2P`, `2P%`, `eFG%`, FT, FTA, `FT%`, ORB, DRB, TRB, AST, STL, BLK, TOV, PF, PTS, Center, `Shooting Guard`, `Small Forward`, `Point Guard`, `Power Forward`, season1, season2, season3, season4, season5)

best.lm <- regsubsets(TOV~., data = df2, 
                     nvmax = 32, nbest=2,
                     method = "exhaustive")
plot(best.lm, scale = "adjr2")

#best subsets on ten variables that seem significant
dfsmall <- select(bball_data, TWP, FGA, FTA, DRB, AST, PF, PTS, MP, FG, TRB, TOV)

best.lm <- regsubsets(TOV~., data = dfsmall, 
                     nvmax = 8, nbest=2,
                     method = "exhaustive")
plot(best.lm, scale = "adjr2")


```


```{r}
#Transformations to our variables

bball_data$sqrtFGA <- sqrt(bball_data$FGA)
bball_data$logFTA <- log(bball_data$FTA)
bball_data$logDRB <- log(bball_data$DRB)
bball_data$logAST <- log(bball_data$AST)
bball_data$logTOV <- log(bball_data$TOV)

#Adding these transformations removed patterns in our residual plots and increased the R^2 value of our reduced model from 0.811 to 0.823

red_logmodel <- lm(data=bball_data, logTOV ~ sqrtFGA + logFTA + logDRB + logAST + PF)
bball_data$resid3<-red_logmodel$residuals
bball_data$fit3<-red_logmodel$fitted.values
bball_data$order<-1:nrow(bball_data)

# We also tried squaring the reduced model to see if adding any interaction helped the model. However, adding the significant terms only increased our R^2 value by 0.004 so we did not include them in the model. 

summary(red_logmodel)

#Regression plots

ggplot(data=bball_data, aes(x=fit3, y=resid3))+
  geom_point()

 
qqnorm(bball_data$resid3)

ggplot(data=bball_data, aes(x=sqrtFGA, y=resid3))+
  geom_point()

ggplot(data=bball_data, aes(x=logFTA, y=resid3))+
  geom_point()

ggplot(data=bball_data, aes(x=logDRB, y=resid3))+
  geom_point()

ggplot(data=bball_data, aes(x=logAST, y=resid3))+
  geom_point()

ggplot(data=bball_data, aes(x=PF, y=resid3))+
  geom_point()



full_model2 <- lm(data=bball_data, logTOV ~ Age + sqrtFGA + logFTA + logDRB + logAST + PF)
summary(full_model2)

#ESS test for age
anova(red_logmodel, full_model2)

bball_data <- mutate(bball_data, resid1 = resid(red_logmodel), resid2 = resid(full_model2))

#residual plots of age for each model
ggplot(data = bball_data, aes(x = Age, y = resid1)) + geom_point() + 
  labs(title = "Residual Plot for First (Reduced) Model")

ggplot(data = bball_data, aes(x = Age, y = resid2)) + geom_point() + 
  labs(title = "Residual Plot for Second (Full) Model")

favstats(bball_data$Age)
```
